description: Re-sign an iOS build with a new provisioning profile, for example after new test iPhones were added to the ad hoc profile, so testers can install without a new build from Xcode or CI. AppForShare signs a copy with the workspace's signing certificate (an Admin adds the .p12 once in Settings) and saves it as a NEW build ("re-signed from build X", same release notes, new SHA-256); the original build and its sign-offs stay as they were. Bundle ID, version and build number never change. Profiles come from the connected App Store Connect key: pass profile names or ids, or leave out for the best active ad hoc, development or enterprise profile of the app. App Store profiles are refused. Without confirm: the check only (profiles, certificate, devices added or dropped, problems). With confirm: true (ask the person first) the re-sign is queued; follow it with build_info (resign.lastResign). Developer role. Pro and Team.

build.description: Build id or the slug of its install link

mergeEntitlements.description: Keep the app's own entitlements where the profile allows them (default: entitlements from the profile)

profiles.description: Names or ids of profiles on the connected Apple account (optional; leave out for the best one for the app)

name: resign_build
title: Re-sign an iOS build with a new profile
